note: Reviewed administrative parent evidence for the three Chinese locations the pinned ILCD resource lists as top-level codes. GeoAtlas states the parent inside each feature, so the parent is read from the source rather than inferred from a code shape, a name similarity or the entry text.
rule: A binding is accepted only when the vendored GeoAtlas feature with that adcode exists exactly once, is level='province', carries the reviewed name below, and states parent.adcode === 100000.
A binding only re-parents an existing ilcd-locations node under the country node. It never creates a node, and never changes a node's code, taxonomy, labels or aliases.
Parenthood is never inferred from a code shape, from a name similarity, or from the archive entry text; code letters are not treated as administrative segments.

source.evidenceField: properties.parent.adcode === 100000 for each bound feature, with level='province'
